rules.question: Which practice section is in force at the playhead?
must_not_match: const auto tempo_past = std::upper_bound(scene.tempos.begin(), scene.tempos.end(), now_tick,

owner_lines.line_text: const auto section = last_at_or_before(sections.begin(), sections.end(), now_tick,
owner_lines.why: build_time_box, the owner: the time box's section line, through the one in-force search

rules.note: A search over the practice sections for the one in force at a tick. build_time_box answers it once, through last_at_or_before (the search SongTiming's tempo and time signature lookups use too); the tempo and the time signature in force are rows in core-measures.json. Sections live outside SongTiming because the .mid reader fills them after build_timing. Listing the sections (hydra_replay's dump) answers another question.
